title: NTM versus MTBC
dek: A bottle full of acid-fast bacilli is not a TB case. MAC, M. abscessus, and M. kansasii share the stain and not the catalogue, not HRZE, and usually not Xpert.
story: Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are environmental and opportunistic. They are acid-fast. They are not MTBC. Xpert and most TB NAATs are designed not to call them — when they do, it is news. A MGIT bottle that is AFB-positive and Xpert-negative is an NTM until proven otherwise, not “smear-positive TB with a failed cartridge.”

M. avium complex, M. abscessus complex, and M. kansasii dominate pulmonary NTM in many clinics. Their DST grammar (macrolides, amikacin, cefoxitin) is not the WHO TB mutation catalogue. Running TBProfiler on an abscessus assembly is a category error.
M. bovis BCG is MTBC, not NTM. M. canettii is MTBC-adjacent. M. leprae is a different disease. Speciation belongs on the same line as rpoB when the specimen is mycobacterial at all.
deepTitle: How labs actually mix them up
deep: Mixed MTBC+NTM cultures: the NAAT sees TB, the bottle overgrows MAC, pDST looks insane.
Some in-house 16S assays call “Mycobacterium spp.” and stop. That is not a TB diagnosis.
M. kansasii can cross-react in older probes. Modern WRDs and WGS trees close the case.
Infection-control: NTM from a dirty ice machine is not a TB outbreak. Do not line-list it as RR-TB.

visual.caption: AFB-positive is a stain. Speciation splits MTBC (catalogue, HRZE/BPaLM) from NTM (different drugs) and from mixed bottles.

example.title: MAC bottle reported as pan-S TB
example.setup: MGIT positive, in-house AFB smear 3+, “TB pDST pan-susceptible,” Xpert never run.

steps.title: Run a WRD or a tree
steps.body: MAC will not have a meaningful rpoB RRDR TB call.

steps.title: Do not start HRZE from a stain
steps.body: MAC therapy is macrolide-based when indicated, not HRZE.

steps.title: Audit the LIS map
steps.body: Bottles defaulting to “TB DST” is a software bug with clinical teeth.

example.takeaway: The catalogue is an MTBC object. Speciate first.

check.prompt: An AFB-positive MGIT with a negative Xpert is most often:
choices: NTM or dead MTBC DNA-negative culture — speciate, do not assume HRZE
check.answer: NTM or dead MTBC DNA-negative culture — speciate, do not assume HRZE
check.why: Stain ≠ species. WRD-negative growth is a speciation problem.

check.prompt: WHO TB mutation catalogue rows apply to:
choices: MTBC genomes (and specified complex members), not MAC/abscessus
check.answer: MTBC genomes (and specified complex members), not MAC/abscessus
check.why: Different species, different drugs, different catalogues.

check.prompt: On the flow map, the NTM path leaves the WRD when:
choices: The WRD is negative or discordant with the bottle
check.answer: The WRD is negative or discordant with the bottle
